stage: frozen exploratory partial-damage mechanism screen, four observed development identities
proxy: first supplied reference is the calibration original, withheld from all proxy conditioning; remaining three references condition the frozen restorer
proxy_mask: reuse supplied target damage-mask coordinates on aligned reference photo; no target landmarks or clean pixels read
proxy_severity: medium fixed for all proxies, not selected from target labels
calibration: per-person weighted ridge least squares on every fourth masked proxy pixel; eight input/output local statistics, standardized; ridge 0.01, unpenalized intercept; no gradient update to restoration model
prediction: clip blend to [0,1], normalized box smoothing radius 2 inside supplied mask; exact observed pixels outside
primary_contrasts: proxy_spatial versus fixed_half and versus proxy_global on FaceNet and hole MAE; four identity-level tests with Holm correction
safeguards: all independent metrics including LPIPS, gallery similarity and visible MAE; visual review; retain all failures
clean_target_access: evaluation only; calibration targets are supplied reference photos, never actual target or withheld gallery
interpretation: mixing coefficients are not calibrated probabilities; proxy-to-target domain shift and alignment mismatch can defeat transfer
progression: do not expand or train a fusion adapter unless spatial calibration improves beyond global/fixed blending without material fidelity/perceptual regressions; otherwise retain a negative result
